title: Patch: a named set of width and height breakpoints for every stylesheet
notes: The web client's screen-size breakpoints are one named set, apps/web/src/breakpoints.ts (phone 600, narrow 760, medium 899, tablet 1024 wide, short 500 tall), and every stylesheet's @media and every script's query sits on it or on a kept value listed with its reason. The card inspect sheet's queries move with them (R2529000 counts apps/web/src/cards/ as how cards look): the rules at reading size show up to 600 px wide, not 560, and the side-by-side sheet on a phone on its side starts at 601 px wide and up to 500 px tall. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: One set of screen sizes
fixes: A card's rules at reading size show on every phone-sized screen, up to 600 px wide.
